verses.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ੬ : ਵਾਹਿਗੁਰੂ ਦੀ ਵ੍ਯਾਪਕਤਾ ਦਾ ਅਨੁਭਵ
verses.translit_en: pauRee 6 : vaahiguroo dhee vayaapakataa dhaa anubhav

en.bdb: Realization of the all-pervasiveness of the wondrous Guru

verses.gurmukhi: ਦਰਪਣਿ ਵਾਂਗ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਧਰਿ ਆਪੁ ਆਪ ਨਿਹਾਲੈ।
verses.translit_en: dharapan vaa(n)g dhiaan dhar aap aap nihaalai|

en.bdb: As is the reflection in the mirror.  He sees in the world His ownself.

verses.gurmukhi: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਹੈ ਚੰਦੁ ਜਲ ਵਿਚਿ ਭਾਲੈ।
verses.translit_en: ghaT ghaT pooran braham hai cha(n)dh jal vich bhaalai|

en.bdb: That perfect Lord is there in all the selves; the ignorant individual searches Him outside as the moon sees its own reflection in the water and feels it is there.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੋਰਸੁ ਗਾਈ ਵੇਖਦਾ ਘਿਉ ਦੁਧੁ ਵਿਚਾਲੈ।
verses.translit_en: goras gaiee vekhadhaa ghiau dhudh vichaalai|

en.bdb: Lord Himself is there in the milk, cow and ghee.

verses.gurmukhi: ਫੁਲਾਂ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਵਾਸੁ ਲੈ ਫਲੁ ਸਾਉ ਸਮ੍ਹਾਲੈ।
verses.translit_en: fulaa(n) a(n)dhar vaas lai fal saau samhaalai|

en.bdb: Taking fragrance from the flowers He Himself is the flavour in them.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਾਸਟਿ ਅਗਨਿ ਚਲਿਤੁ ਵੇਖਿ ਜਲ ਧਰਤਿ ਹਿਆਲੈ।
verses.translit_en: kaasaT agan chalit vekh jal dharat hiaalai|

en.bdb: His own phenomenon is there in wood, fire, water, earth and snow.

verses.gurmukhi: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਪੂਰਨੁ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵੇਖਾਲੈ ॥੬॥
verses.translit_en: ghaT ghaT pooran braham hai gurmukh vekhaalai ||6||

en.bdb: The perfect Lord resides in all the selves and is visualised by a rare gurmukh.
